title: 橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設
subcategoryTitle: 橋梁施工工法與大型架設
subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge construction methods and heavy erection
summary: 從簡支箱梁的正彎矩與體外預力需求出發，計算架橋機對橋墩的施工荷載，再處理乾接縫與環氧接縫、轉向塊與錨碇橫隔、架橋機推進穩定、整跨荷重轉換與預製場幾何控制，最後以鋼腱振動頻率、接縫監測與可更換性驗收交接，並以佛州 Long Key 橋、Seven Mile 橋與曼谷 Bang Na 高架道路為案例。
summaryEn: Starting from the sagging moment and external prestress demand of a simple-span box girder, compute gantry construction loads on the piers, then handle dry and epoxy joints, deviators and anchorage diaphragms, gantry launching stability, whole-span load transfer and casting-yard geometry control, and finally accept and hand over with tendon vibration checks, joint monitoring and replaceability, using Florida's Long Key and Seven Mile bridges and Bangkok's Bang Na Expressway as cases.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求」與「架橋機與橋墩的施工期荷載」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection" and "Gantry construction loads on the piers": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「整跨箱梁與體外鋼腱」如何影響橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Whole-span box and external tendons” governs force, deformation or durability in “Span-by-span precast bridge erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 逐跨工法把一整跨的預鑄節塊（常見 10 至 14 塊）同時懸吊或擱置在架橋機或下承桁架上，調整線形後一次張拉縱向鋼腱，使整跨立刻成為能自承重的簡支梁，再把架橋機推到下一跨。因為所有節塊在張拉前都由臨時結構承托，接縫在施工期不需承受懸臂彎矩，箱梁可以用等高度斷面，最適合跨度約 30 至 45 m、跨數很多的長距離高架橋。鋼腱多採體外配置，沿箱內由錨碇橫隔經轉向塊折線布設，近似拋物線的偏心抵抗跨中正彎矩。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「整跨箱梁與體外鋼腱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Span-by-span erection hangs or rests a whole span of precast segments, commonly 10 to 14, on an overhead gantry or underslung truss, aligns them, then stresses the longitudinal tendons in one operation so the span immediately becomes a self-supporting simple beam before the gantry moves on. Because all segments are carried by temporary works until stressing, the joints never carry cantilever moment during construction and the box can have constant depth, ideal for long viaducts with many spans of about 30 to 45 m. Tendons are usually external, running inside the box from anchorage diaphragm to deviators in a polygonal profile whose eccentricity approximates a parabola to resist midspan sagging moment. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Whole-span box and external tendons” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：簡支跨 L = 42 m、自重 w = 180 kN/m：M_DL = wL²/8 = 39,690 kN·m；加鋪面 50 kN/m 的 11,025 kN·m 與活載 12,000 kN·m，合計 M = 62,715 kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Simple span L = 42 m, self-weight w = 180 kN/m: M_DL = wL²/8 = 39,690 kN·m; adding 11,025 kN·m from 50 kN/m surfacing and 12,000 kN·m of live load gives M = 62,715 kN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「逐跨架設的節塊接縫在營運時可以像鋼筋混凝土一樣容許開裂。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Joints in span-by-span segmental spans may crack in service just like reinforced concrete." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「整跨箱梁與體外鋼腱」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Whole-span box and external tendons”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求
knowledge.titleEn: Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection
knowledge.text: 逐跨工法把一整跨的預鑄節塊（常見 10 至 14 塊）同時懸吊或擱置在架橋機或下承桁架上，調整線形後一次張拉縱向鋼腱，使整跨立刻成為能自承重的簡支梁，再把架橋機推到下一跨。因為所有節塊在張拉前都由臨時結構承托，接縫在施工期不需承受懸臂彎矩，箱梁可以用等高度斷面，最適合跨度約 30 至 45 m、跨數很多的長距離高架橋。
knowledge.textEn: Span-by-span erection hangs or rests a whole span of precast segments, commonly 10 to 14, on an overhead gantry or underslung truss, aligns them, then stresses the longitudinal tendons in one operation so the span immediately becomes a self-supporting simple beam before the gantry moves on. Because all segments are carried by temporary works until stressing, the joints never carry cantilever moment during construction and the box can have constant depth, ideal for long viaducts with many spans of about 30 to 45 m.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：逐跨架設的節塊接縫在營運時可以像鋼筋混凝土一樣容許開裂。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Joints in span-by-span segmental spans may crack in service just like reinforced concrete. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設」的「逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求：機制與傳力路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出載重來源、構件、接點與支承的傳力邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「城市結構維護班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與幾何版本、支承條件、荷載方向與獨立位移紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection: mechanism and load path” in “Span-by-span precast bridge erection”. Draw the load, member, connection and support load paths; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Urban structures maintenance shift” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for geometry revision, supports, load direction and independent displacement records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection" is correct?
options: 逐跨架設的節塊接縫在營運時可以像鋼筋混凝土一樣容許開裂。
逐跨工法把一整跨的預鑄節塊（常見 10 至 14 塊）同時懸吊或擱置在架橋機或下承桁架上，調整線形後一次張拉縱向鋼腱，使整跨立刻成為能自承重的簡支梁，再把架橋機推到下一跨。
架橋機的荷重只是暫時的，橋墩照營運荷載設計就足夠。
optionsEn: Joints in span-by-span segmental spans may crack in service just like reinforced concrete.

Span-by-span erection hangs or rests a whole span of precast segments, commonly 10 to 14, on an overhead gantry or underslung truss, aligns them, then stresses the longitudinal tendons in one operation so the span immediately becomes a self-supporting simple beam before the gantry moves on.
Gantry loads are only temporary, so piers designed for service loads are always sufficient.
quiz.explanation: 逐跨工法把一整跨的預鑄節塊（常見 10 至 14 塊）同時懸吊或擱置在架橋機或下承桁架上，調整線形後一次張拉縱向鋼腱，使整跨立刻成為能自承重的簡支梁，再把架橋機推到下一跨。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Span-by-span erection hangs or rests a whole span of precast segments, commonly 10 to 14, on an overhead gantry or underslung truss, aligns them, then stresses the longitudinal tendons in one operation so the span immediately becomes a self-supporting simple beam before the gantry moves on. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「整跨箱梁與體外鋼腱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Whole-span box and external tendons” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：簡支跨 L = 42 m、自重 w = 180 kN/m：M_DL = wL²/8 = 39,690 kN·m；加鋪面 50 kN/m 的 11,025 kN·m 與活載 12,000 kN·m，合計 M = 62,715 kN·m。斷面 A = 7.2 m²、S_b = 4.0 m³、跨中偏心 e = 1.0 m，底緣保留 0.7 MPa 壓應力：P ≥ (62,715/4.0 + 700)/(1/7.2 + 1.0/4.0) ≈ 42,120 kN，取 12 束 × 3,600 kN = 43,200 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Simple span L = 42 m, self-weight w = 180 kN/m: M_DL = wL²/8 = 39,690 kN·m; adding 11,025 kN·m from 50 kN/m surfacing and 12,000 kN·m of live load gives M = 62,715 kN·m. With A = 7.2 m², S_b = 4.0 m³, midspan eccentricity e = 1.0 m and 0.7 MPa residual bottom compression, P ≥ (62,715/4.0 + 700)/(1/7.2 + 1.0/4.0) ≈ 42,120 kN; use 12 tendons × 3,600 kN = 43,200 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段模型檢查三個狀態：節塊懸吊於架橋機（梁體無預力）、張拉完成後架橋機卸載（自重加預力）、營運滿載（含鋪面與活載），每個狀態列出每一接縫上下緣應力，確認接縫在所有使用狀態都維持設計規定的殘餘壓應力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check three states in a construction-stage model: segments hanging from the gantry with no prestress, after stressing with the gantry unloaded (self-weight plus prestress), and full service load with surfacing and live load, listing top and bottom stresses at every joint and confirming that each joint keeps the specified residual compression in all service states.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Simple span L = 42 m, self-weight w = 180 kN/m: M_DL = wL²/8 = 39,690 kN·m; adding 11,025 kN·m from 50 kN/m surfacing and 12,000 kN·m of live load gives M = 62,715 kN·m. With A = 7.2 m², S_b = 4.0 m³, midspan eccentricity e = 1.0 m and 0.7 MPa residual bottom compression, P ≥ (62,715/4.0 + 700)/(1/7.2 + 1.0/4.0) ≈ 42,120 kN; use 12 tendons × 3,600 kN = 43,200 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection", which statement holds?
options: 體外鋼腱不埋在混凝土裡，所以轉向塊只需要很少的鋼筋。
張拉完成後只要拆除吊桿，荷重自然會平均傳到四個支承。
簡支跨 L = 42 m、自重 w = 180 kN/m：M_DL = wL²/8 = 39,690 kN·m。
optionsEn: Because external tendons are not embedded, deviators need very little reinforcement.
After stressing, removing the hangers automatically shares the load equally among the four bearings.
Simple span L = 42 m, self-weight w = 180 kN/m: M_DL = wL²/8 = 39,690 kN·m.
quiz.explanation: 簡支跨 L = 42 m、自重 w = 180 kN/m：M_DL = wL²/8 = 39,690 kN·m；加鋪面 50 kN/m 的 11,025 kN·m 與活載 12,000 kN·m，合計 M = 62,715 kN·m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Simple span L = 42 m, self-weight w = 180 kN/m: M_DL = wL²/8 = 39,690 kN·m; adding 11,025 kN·m from 50 kN/m surfacing and 12,000 kN·m of live load gives M = 62,715 kN·m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「整跨箱梁與體外鋼腱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Whole-span box and external tendons” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工階段模型檢查三個狀態：節塊懸吊於架橋機（梁體無預力）、張拉完成後架橋機卸載（自重加預力）、營運滿載（含鋪面與活載），每個狀態列出每一接縫上下緣應力，確認接縫在所有使用狀態都維持設計規定的殘餘壓應力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check three states in a construction-stage model: segments hanging from the gantry with no prestress, after stressing with the gantry unloaded (self-weight plus prestress), and full service load with surfacing and live load, listing top and bottom stresses at every joint and confirming that each joint keeps the specified residual compression in all service states. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計圖說應明列每一跨的節塊編號、鋼腱編號與張拉順序，並註明接縫殘餘壓應力的設計值，作為施工與日後評估的共同基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Drawings should list segment numbers, tendon numbers and stressing order for every span and state the design residual joint compression, as a shared basis for construction and later assessment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把預鑄節塊箱梁當作一般連續鋼筋混凝土梁設計，忽略接縫處沒有連續鋼筋，活載下跨中接縫會張開，雨水與鹽分直接進入箱內，體外鋼腱錨頭與轉向塊加速腐蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing a precast segmental box like an ordinary reinforced girder, ignoring that no reinforcement crosses the joints, lets midspan joints open under live load so rain and salt enter the box and accelerate corrosion at external tendon anchors and deviators. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以施工階段模型檢查三個狀態：節塊懸吊於架橋機（梁體無預力）、張拉完成後架橋機卸載（自重加預力）、營運滿載（含鋪面與活載），每個狀態列出每一接縫上下緣應力，確認接縫在所有使用狀態都維持設計規定的殘餘壓應力。
knowledge.textEn: Check three states in a construction-stage model: segments hanging from the gantry with no prestress, after stressing with the gantry unloaded (self-weight plus prestress), and full service load with surfacing and live load, listing top and bottom stresses at every joint and confirming that each joint keeps the specified residual compression in all service states.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計圖說應明列每一跨的節塊編號、鋼腱編號與張拉順序，並註明接縫殘餘壓應力的設計值，作為施工與日後評估的共同基準。
knowledge.textEn: Drawings should list segment numbers, tendon numbers and stressing order for every span and state the design residual joint compression, as a shared basis for construction and later assessment.

quiz.question: 要驗證「逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection"?
options: 以施工階段模型檢查三個狀態：節塊懸吊於架橋機（梁體無預力）、張拉完成後架橋機卸載（自重加預力）、營運滿載（含鋪面與活載），每個狀態列出每一接縫上下緣應力，確認接縫在所有使用狀態都維持設計規定的殘餘壓應力。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
體外鋼腱張拉完成後力量不會改變，所以不需要再量測。
optionsEn: Check three states in a construction-stage model: segments hanging from the gantry with no prestress, after stressing with the gantry unloaded (self-weight plus prestress), and full service load with surfacing and live load, listing top and bottom stresses at every joint and confirming that each joint keeps the specified residual compression in all service states.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Once stressed, an external tendon's force never changes, so it need not be measured again.
quiz.explanation: 以施工階段模型檢查三個狀態：節塊懸吊於架橋機（梁體無預力）、張拉完成後架橋機卸載（自重加預力）、營運滿載（含鋪面與活載），每個狀態列出每一接縫上下緣應力，確認接縫在所有使用狀態都維持設計規定的殘餘壓應力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check three states in a construction-stage model: segments hanging from the gantry with no prestress, after stressing with the gantry unloaded (self-weight plus prestress), and full service load with surfacing and live load, listing top and bottom stresses at every joint and confirming that each joint keeps the specified residual compression in all service states. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「整跨箱梁與體外鋼腱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Whole-span box and external tendons” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把預鑄節塊箱梁當作一般連續鋼筋混凝土梁設計，忽略接縫處沒有連續鋼筋，活載下跨中接縫會張開，雨水與鹽分直接進入箱內，體外鋼腱錨頭與轉向塊加速腐蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing a precast segmental box like an ordinary reinforced girder, ignoring that no reinforcement crosses the joints, lets midspan joints open under live load so rain and salt enter the box and accelerate corrosion at external tendon anchors and deviators. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鋼腱多採體外配置，沿箱內由錨碇橫隔經轉向塊折線布設，近似拋物線的偏心抵抗跨中正彎矩。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Tendons are usually external, running inside the box from anchorage diaphragm to deviators in a polygonal profile whose eccentricity approximates a parabola to resist midspan sagging moment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「逐跨架設的節塊接縫在營運時可以像鋼筋混凝土一樣容許開裂。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Joints in span-by-span segmental spans may crack in service just like reinforced concrete." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把預鑄節塊箱梁當作一般連續鋼筋混凝土梁設計，忽略接縫處沒有連續鋼筋，活載下跨中接縫會張開，雨水與鹽分直接進入箱內，體外鋼腱錨頭與轉向塊加速腐蝕。
knowledge.textEn: Designing a precast segmental box like an ordinary reinforced girder, ignoring that no reinforcement crosses the joints, lets midspan joints open under live load so rain and salt enter the box and accelerate corrosion at external tendon anchors and deviators.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若把預鑄節塊箱梁當作一般連續鋼筋混凝土梁設計，忽略接縫處沒有連續鋼筋，活載下跨中接縫會張開，雨水與鹽分直接進入箱內，體外鋼腱錨頭與轉向塊加速腐蝕。
架橋機的荷重只是暫時的，橋墩照營運荷載設計就足夠。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Designing a precast segmental box like an ordinary reinforced girder, ignoring that no reinforcement crosses the joints, lets midspan joints open under live load so rain and salt enter the box and accelerate corrosion at external tendon anchors and deviators.
Gantry loads are only temporary, so piers designed for service loads are always sufficient.
quiz.explanation: 若把預鑄節塊箱梁當作一般連續鋼筋混凝土梁設計，忽略接縫處沒有連續鋼筋，活載下跨中接縫會張開，雨水與鹽分直接進入箱內，體外鋼腱錨頭與轉向塊加速腐蝕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing a precast segmental box like an ordinary reinforced girder, ignoring that no reinforcement crosses the joints, lets midspan joints open under live load so rain and salt enter the box and accelerate corrosion at external tendon anchors and deviators. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 架橋機與橋墩的施工期荷載：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Gantry construction loads on the piers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「架橋機支腿反力」如何影響橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gantry leg reactions” governs force, deformation or durability in “Span-by-span precast bridge erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 整跨節塊在張拉前全部重量經由架橋機傳到前後兩座橋墩，架橋機自重也一併加上；支腿通常放在墩帽或已完成箱梁的端部，與墩柱軸線有偏心，墩柱在施工期承受營運時不會出現的單側彎矩。架橋機推進時重心沿縱向移動，風力又作用在高聳的主桁與節塊上，所以墩帽承壓、墩柱彎矩、基礎與支承臨時鎖定都要以施工荷載逐一檢核，而不是只套用營運荷載組合。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「架橋機支腿反力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before stressing, the entire weight of a span of segments, plus the gantry's own weight, passes through the gantry to the two piers; legs usually sit on the pier cap or on the end of the completed girder, eccentric to the column axis, so the column carries one-sided bending that never occurs in service. As the gantry launches, its centre of gravity moves along the bridge and wind acts on the tall girders and hanging segments, so pier-cap bearing, column bending, foundations and temporary bearing locks must each be checked for construction loads rather than service combinations alone. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Gantry leg reactions” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一跨節塊 W = 180×42 = 7,560 kN，架橋機在該跨的自重 4,000 kN，兩支腿平均反力 R = (7,560 + 4,000)/2 = 5,780 kN；支腿距墩軸偏心 1.2 m 時墩柱施工彎矩 M = 5,780×1.2 ≈ 6,936 kN·m，須與墩柱設計彎矩與基礎承載比較。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: One span of segments weighs W = 180×42 = 7,560 kN and the gantry contributes 4,000 kN over that span, so each of the two legs carries on average R = (7,560 + 4,000)/2 = 5,780 kN; with a 1.2 m leg eccentricity from the pier axis the construction moment in the column is M = 5,780×1.2 ≈ 6,936 kN·m, to be compared with the column and foundation capacity.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「架橋機的荷重只是暫時的，橋墩照營運荷載設計就足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Gantry loads are only temporary, so piers designed for service loads are always sufficient." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「架橋機支腿反力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Gantry leg reactions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 架橋機與橋墩的施工期荷載
knowledge.titleEn: Gantry construction loads on the piers
knowledge.text: 整跨節塊在張拉前全部重量經由架橋機傳到前後兩座橋墩，架橋機自重也一併加上；支腿通常放在墩帽或已完成箱梁的端部，與墩柱軸線有偏心，墩柱在施工期承受營運時不會出現的單側彎矩。架橋機推進時重心沿縱向移動，風力又作用在高聳的主桁與節塊上，所以墩帽承壓、墩柱彎矩、基礎與支承臨時鎖定都要以施工荷載逐一檢核，而不是只套用營運荷載組合。
knowledge.textEn: Before stressing, the entire weight of a span of segments, plus the gantry's own weight, passes through the gantry to the two piers; legs usually sit on the pier cap or on the end of the completed girder, eccentric to the column axis, so the column carries one-sided bending that never occurs in service. As the gantry launches, its centre of gravity moves along the bridge and wind acts on the tall girders and hanging segments, so pier-cap bearing, column bending, foundations and temporary bearing locks must each be checked for construction loads rather than service combinations alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：架橋機的荷重只是暫時的，橋墩照營運荷載設計就足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Gantry loads are only temporary, so piers designed for service loads are always sufficient. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「架橋機與橋墩的施工期荷載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gantry construction loads on the piers" is correct?
options: 架橋機的荷重只是暫時的，橋墩照營運荷載設計就足夠。
乾接縫只是少塗一層環氧，結構行為與環氧接縫完全相同。
整跨節塊在張拉前全部重量經由架橋機傳到前後兩座橋墩，架橋機自重也一併加上。
optionsEn: Gantry loads are only temporary, so piers designed for service loads are always sufficient.
A dry joint is just an epoxy joint without the epoxy and behaves identically.
Before stressing, the entire weight of a span of segments, plus the gantry's own weight, passes through the gantry to the two piers.
quiz.explanation: 整跨節塊在張拉前全部重量經由架橋機傳到前後兩座橋墩，架橋機自重也一併加上；支腿通常放在墩帽或已完成箱梁的端部，與墩柱軸線有偏心，墩柱在施工期承受營運時不會出現的單側彎矩。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before stressing, the entire weight of a span of segments, plus the gantry's own weight, passes through the gantry to the two piers; legs usually sit on the pier cap or on the end of the completed girder, eccentric to the column axis, so the column carries one-sided bending that never occurs in service. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 架橋機與橋墩的施工期荷載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gantry construction loads on the piers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「架橋機支腿反力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gantry leg reactions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一跨節塊 W = 180×42 = 7,560 kN，架橋機在該跨的自重 4,000 kN，兩支腿平均反力 R = (7,560 + 4,000)/2 = 5,780 kN；支腿距墩軸偏心 1.2 m 時墩柱施工彎矩 M = 5,780×1.2 ≈ 6,936 kN·m，須與墩柱設計彎矩與基礎承載比較。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: One span of segments weighs W = 180×42 = 7,560 kN and the gantry contributes 4,000 kN over that span, so each of the two legs carries on average R = (7,560 + 4,000)/2 = 5,780 kN; with a 1.2 m leg eccentricity from the pier axis the construction moment in the column is M = 5,780×1.2 ≈ 6,936 kN·m, to be compared with the column and foundation capacity. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：架橋機供應商須提供各工況（空載推進、懸吊整跨、張拉、颱風停機）的支腿反力表，由橋梁設計單位對照墩帽、墩柱與基礎容量逐項確認；首跨架設時在支腿下設荷重計或以油壓讀值監測實際反力，與表列值比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The gantry supplier must provide leg-reaction tables for each case (empty launch, full span hanging, stressing, storm parking), which the bridge designer checks against pier-cap, column and foundation capacity item by item; on the first span, monitor real reactions with load cells or hydraulic readings under the legs and compare with the table.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 一跨節塊 W = 180×42 = 7,560 kN，架橋機在該跨的自重 4,000 kN，兩支腿平均反力 R = (7,560 + 4,000)/2 = 5,780 kN；支腿距墩軸偏心 1.2 m 時墩柱施工彎矩 M = 5,780×1.2 ≈ 6,936 kN·m，須與墩柱設計彎矩與基礎承載比較。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: One span of segments weighs W = 180×42 = 7,560 kN and the gantry contributes 4,000 kN over that span, so each of the two legs carries on average R = (7,560 + 4,000)/2 = 5,780 kN; with a 1.2 m leg eccentricity from the pier axis the construction moment in the column is M = 5,780×1.2 ≈ 6,936 kN·m, to be compared with the column and foundation capacity. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「架橋機與橋墩的施工期荷載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Gantry construction loads on the piers", which statement holds?
options: 架橋機本身很重，所以推進時不可能傾覆。
預製場的模板精度夠高，就不需要逐塊量測幾何。
optionsEn: One span of segments weighs W = 180×42 = 7,560 kN and the gantry contributes 4,000 kN over that span, so each of the two legs carries on average R = (7,560 + 4,000)/2 = 5,780 kN.
A gantry is so heavy that it cannot overturn while launching.
If the yard forms are accurate enough, segment geometry need not be surveyed one by one.
quiz.explanation: 一跨節塊 W = 180×42 = 7,560 kN，架橋機在該跨的自重 4,000 kN，兩支腿平均反力 R = (7,560 + 4,000)/2 = 5,780 kN；支腿距墩軸偏心 1.2 m 時墩柱施工彎矩 M = 5,780×1.2 ≈ 6,936 kN·m，須與墩柱設計彎矩與基礎承載比較。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: One span of segments weighs W = 180×42 = 7,560 kN and the gantry contributes 4,000 kN over that span, so each of the two legs carries on average R = (7,560 + 4,000)/2 = 5,780 kN; with a 1.2 m leg eccentricity from the pier axis the construction moment in the column is M = 5,780×1.2 ≈ 6,936 kN·m, to be compared with the column and foundation capacity. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 架橋機與橋墩的施工期荷載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gantry construction loads on the piers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「架橋機支腿反力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gantry leg reactions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 架橋機供應商須提供各工況（空載推進、懸吊整跨、張拉、颱風停機）的支腿反力表，由橋梁設計單位對照墩帽、墩柱與基礎容量逐項確認；首跨架設時在支腿下設荷重計或以油壓讀值監測實際反力，與表列值比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The gantry supplier must provide leg-reaction tables for each case (empty launch, full span hanging, stressing, storm parking), which the bridge designer checks against pier-cap, column and foundation capacity item by item; on the first span, monitor real reactions with load cells or hydraulic readings under the legs and compare with the table. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把架橋機支腿位置、最大反力與停機條件（例如風速上限）寫入橋墩設計說明與施工計畫，任何更換架橋機或改變支腿位置都需重新送審。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Write gantry leg positions, maximum reactions and parking conditions, such as a wind-speed limit, into the pier design notes and the construction plan, and require resubmission for any change of gantry or leg position.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支腿落在墩帽邊緣或未經設計的位置，可能壓碎墩帽混凝土或使支承墊石開裂；若颱風停機時未鎖定架橋機並降低懸吊荷重，側風可能使架橋機橫移甚至倒塌，砸毀已完成的跨。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Legs landing near the edge of a pier cap or at an undesigned position can crush the cap concrete or crack bearing plinths; if the gantry is not locked and unloaded when parked for a typhoon, cross-wind can slide or topple it onto completed spans. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 架橋機供應商須提供各工況（空載推進、懸吊整跨、張拉、颱風停機）的支腿反力表，由橋梁設計單位對照墩帽、墩柱與基礎容量逐項確認；首跨架設時在支腿下設荷重計或以油壓讀值監測實際反力，與表列值比較。
knowledge.textEn: The gantry supplier must provide leg-reaction tables for each case (empty launch, full span hanging, stressing, storm parking), which the bridge designer checks against pier-cap, column and foundation capacity item by item; on the first span, monitor real reactions with load cells or hydraulic readings under the legs and compare with the table.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把架橋機支腿位置、最大反力與停機條件（例如風速上限）寫入橋墩設計說明與施工計畫，任何更換架橋機或改變支腿位置都需重新送審。
knowledge.textEn: Write gantry leg positions, maximum reactions and parking conditions, such as a wind-speed limit, into the pier design notes and the construction plan, and require resubmission for any change of gantry or leg position.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 架橋機與橋墩的施工期荷載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gantry construction loads on the piers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「架橋機支腿反力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gantry leg reactions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 支腿落在墩帽邊緣或未經設計的位置，可能壓碎墩帽混凝土或使支承墊石開裂；若颱風停機時未鎖定架橋機並降低懸吊荷重，側風可能使架橋機橫移甚至倒塌，砸毀已完成的跨。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Legs landing near the edge of a pier cap or at an undesigned position can crush the cap concrete or crack bearing plinths; if the gantry is not locked and unloaded when parked for a typhoon, cross-wind can slide or topple it onto completed spans. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：架橋機推進時重心沿縱向移動，風力又作用在高聳的主桁與節塊上，所以墩帽承壓、墩柱彎矩、基礎與支承臨時鎖定都要以施工荷載逐一檢核，而不是只套用營運荷載組合。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: As the gantry launches, its centre of gravity moves along the bridge and wind acts on the tall girders and hanging segments, so pier-cap bearing, column bending, foundations and temporary bearing locks must each be checked for construction loads rather than service combinations alone.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「架橋機的荷重只是暫時的，橋墩照營運荷載設計就足夠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Gantry loads are only temporary, so piers designed for service loads are always sufficient." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 支腿落在墩帽邊緣或未經設計的位置，可能壓碎墩帽混凝土或使支承墊石開裂；若颱風停機時未鎖定架橋機並降低懸吊荷重，側風可能使架橋機橫移甚至倒塌，砸毀已完成的跨。
knowledge.textEn: Legs landing near the edge of a pier cap or at an undesigned position can crush the cap concrete or crack bearing plinths; if the gantry is not locked and unloaded when parked for a typhoon, cross-wind can slide or topple it onto completed spans.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「架橋機與橋墩的施工期荷載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gantry construction loads on the piers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
乾接縫只是少塗一層環氧，結構行為與環氧接縫完全相同。
支腿落在墩帽邊緣或未經設計的位置，可能壓碎墩帽混凝土或使支承墊石開裂；若颱風停機時未鎖定架橋機並降低懸吊荷重，側風可能使架橋機橫移甚至倒塌，砸毀已完成的跨。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A dry joint is just an epoxy joint without the epoxy and behaves identically.
Legs landing near the edge of a pier cap or at an undesigned position can crush the cap concrete or crack bearing plinths.
quiz.explanation: 支腿落在墩帽邊緣或未經設計的位置，可能壓碎墩帽混凝土或使支承墊石開裂；若颱風停機時未鎖定架橋機並降低懸吊荷重，側風可能使架橋機橫移甚至倒塌，砸毀已完成的跨。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Legs landing near the edge of a pier cap or at an undesigned position can crush the cap concrete or crack bearing plinths; if the gantry is not locked and unloaded when parked for a typhoon, cross-wind can slide or topple it onto completed spans. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
